        "contents": "# Contextual Intelligence Implementation Status\n\n**Date:** June 20, 2025  \n**Time:** Implementation completed on 2025-06-20 at 2:35 AM CST  \n**Author:** Claude Code  \n**Branch:** feat/code-recovery  \n\n## Overview\n\nSuccessfully implemented contextual intelligence system for the mindmap functionality that transforms user experience from overwhelming data exploration to guided, coherent knowledge graph building. The system detects when the first record is added to establish context, then intelligently filters all subsequent record additions to maintain narrative coherence.\n\n## Core Problem Solved\n\n**Before:** Users could add any random records to mindmap, creating scattered, unrelated visualizations that provided little insight.\n\n**After:** First record click allows open exploration to establish context. All subsequent clicks intelligently filter to show only related records, creating focused knowledge graphs that tell coherent stories (perfect for guided Disclosure narrative tours starting from Roswell 1947).\n\n## Files Created/Modified\n\n### New Files Created\n\n1. **&#96;/Users/liamellis/Desktop/ultraterrestrial-resurrection/apps/app/src/features/mindmap/utils/contextual-intelligence.ts&#96;**\n   - Core contextual intelligence logic\n   - Functions: &#96;getGraphContext()&#96;, &#96;isRecordRelated()&#96;, &#96;generateContextualSearchRules()&#96;\n   - Context detection algorithms\n   - Relationship analysis and filtering\n\n### Files Modified\n\n1. **&#96;/Users/liamellis/Desktop/ultraterrestrial-resurrection/apps/app/src/features/mindmap/components/menus/mindmap-bottom-menu/mindmap-bottom-menu.tsx&#96;**\n   - **Lines Modified:** Import statements, &#96;handleLoadingRecords()&#96; function (~lines 326-505), &#96;runSearch()&#96; function (~lines 202-310)\n   - **Functionality Added:**\n     - Context detection integration\n     - Conditional query generation based on context\n     - Visual indicators for contextual vs open exploration modes\n     - Enhanced user input node data with context information\n\n## Key Features Implemented\n\n",

        "contents": "class KnowledgeBaseCRUD:\n\n    \n    ...\n\n    \n    def _get_doc_path(self, doc_type: str, doc_id: str, filename: str) -\u003e Path:\n        \"\"\"Get the file path for a document with date-based organization\"\"\"\n        from datetime import datetime\n        \n        base_paths = {\n            \"case_file\": self.case_files_path,\n            \"transcript\": self.transcripts_path,\n            \"article\": self.articles_path,\n            \"research\": self.research_path\n        }\n        base_path = base_paths.get(doc_type, self.kb_path)\n        \n        # Use date-based organization: YYYY-MM-DD/doc_id/\n        date_folder = datetime.now().strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")\n        return base_path / date_folder / doc_id / filename\n    \n    # CREATE\n    def create_document(self, \n                       title: str, \n                       content: str, \n                       source: str,\n                       doc_type: str,\n                       metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,\n                       tags: Optional[List[str]] = None) -\u003e Document:\n        \"\"\"Create a new document in the knowledge base\"\"\"\n        doc_id = self._generate_id(content)\n        now = datetime.now().isoformat()\n        \n        # Create document object\n        doc = Document(\n            id=doc_id,\n            title=title,\n            content=content,\n            source=source,\n            doc_type=doc_type,\n            created_at=now,\n            updated_at=now,\n            metadata=metadata or {},\n            tags=tags or []\n        )\n        \n        # Create document directory\n        doc_dir = self._get_doc_path(doc_type, doc_id, \"\").parent\n        doc_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n        \n        # Save content\n        content_file = self._get_doc_path(doc_type, doc_id, \"content.md\")\n        with open(content_file, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:\n            f.write(content)\n        \n        # Save metadata\n        meta_file = self._get_doc_path(doc_type, doc_id, \"metadata.json\")",

        "contents": "## Project Development\n\n- Remember we use python3\n- ALWAYS INCLUDE THE EXACT DATA AND TIME IN ANY DOCUMENTATION!\n\n## Documentation Guidelines\n\n- Always write a summary of your work, features worked on, files touched, components effected and next steps\n- Always update this doc when you finish any incremental task or code or feature\n- Always timestamp the update\n\n## Work Log - June 29, 2025\n\n### Dual RAG Integration Implementation\n\n**Status**: Complete (Architecture \u0026 Code) | Testing Pending (Environment Setup)\n\n#### Features Implemented\n\n1. **Dual RAG Adapter** - &#96;apps/disclosure-rag/lib/adapters/dual_rag_adapter.py&#96;\n   - Parallel search across Upstash (cloud) and CocoIndex (local)\n   - Intelligent result merging with score weighting\n   - Environment-based configuration and fallback handling\n   - Error resilience and graceful degradation\n\n2. **Enhanced FastAPI Endpoints** - &#96;apps/disclosure-rag/api_server.py&#96;\n   - &#96;POST /rag/search&#96; - Dual system semantic search\n   - &#96;GET /rag/status&#96; - System health monitoring\n   - &#96;POST /rag/index&#96; - Document indexing to both systems\n   - Backward compatibility with existing endpoints\n\n3. **Frontend RAG Integration** - &#96;apps/app/src/lib/rag/rag-llm-handler.ts&#96;\n   - Updated to use new dual search endpoints\n   - Automatic fallback to legacy search if dual RAG unavailable\n   - Enhanced result format with system metadata\n\n4. **UI Source Indicators** - &#96;apps/app/src/components/research/extensions/research-mention-suggestion.tsx&#96;\n   - Visual badges showing result source (☁️ Cloud, 💾 Local)\n   - Enhanced mention suggestions with system information\n   - Preserved existing UI patterns and styling\n\n#### Files Created/Modified\n\n- **NEW**: &#96;apps/disclosure-rag/lib/adapters/dual_rag_adapter.py&#96;         "originalContents": "## Project Development\n\n- Remember we use python3\n- ALWAYS INCLUDE THE EXACT DATA AND TIME IN ANY DOCUMENTATION!\n\n## Documentation Guidelines\n\n- Always write a summary of your work, features worked on, files touched, components effected and next steps\n- Always update this doc when you finish any incremental task or code or feature\n- Always timestamp the update\n\n## Work Log - June 29, 2025\n\n### Dual RAG Integration Implementation\n\n**Status**: Complete (Architecture \u0026 Code) | Testing Pending (Environment Setup)\n\n#### Features Implemented\n\n1. **Dual RAG Adapter** - &#96;apps/disclosure-rag/lib/adapters/dual_rag_adapter.py&#96;\n   - Parallel search across Upstash (cloud) and CocoIndex (local)\n   - Intelligent result merging with score weighting\n   - Environment-based configuration and fallback handling\n   - Error resilience and graceful degradation\n\n2. **Enhanced FastAPI Endpoints** - &#96;apps/disclosure-rag/api_server.py&#96;\n   - &#96;POST /rag/search&#96; - Dual system semantic search\n   - &#96;GET /rag/status&#96; - System health monitoring\n   - &#96;POST /rag/index&#96; - Document indexing to both systems\n   - Backward compatibility with existing endpoints\n\n3. **Frontend RAG Integration** - &#96;apps/app/src/lib/rag/rag-llm-handler.ts&#96;\n   - Updated to use new dual search endpoints\n   - Automatic fallback to legacy search if dual RAG unavailable\n   - Enhanced result format with system metadata\n\n4. **UI Source Indicators** - &#96;apps/app/src/components/research/extensions/research-mention-suggestion.tsx&#96;\n   - Visual badges showing result source (☁️ Cloud, 💾 Local)\n   - Enhanced mention suggestions with system information\n   - Preserved existing UI patterns and styling\n\n#### Files Created/Modified\n\n- **NEW**: &#96;apps/disclosure-rag/lib/adapters/dual_rag_adapter.py&#96;         "contents": "Disclosure Timeline\n\n\u003chttps://www.disclosurediaries.com/timeline\u003e\n\nThis page provides a brief history/timeline overview of the major Disclosure-related events that have occurred from the end of 2017 up to the present day. The timeline focuses on reputable news publications, official (US) Governmental hearings, announcements and statements, as well as testimonies provided on the record/under oath by credible witnesses and whistleblowers.\n\nFor more information on the **Key People** mentioned on this page – [click here.](https://www.disclosurediaries.com/key-people-in-disclosure-uap/)\n\nFor a list of **Important Definitions** used on this page – [click here.](https://www.disclosurediaries.com/important-definitions/)\n\n---\n\n✏️*****Author's Note – \"Why does the timeline start in 2017?\"*****  \n**While there have certainly been many interesting developments prior to 2017, the NYT article published in December of that year was (for many) a significant turning point in terms of the seriousness of discourse. In my view – December 2017 is when the Overton Window for disclosure made its first notable shift.**  \n  \n**The final outcome of this disclosure process is not at all clear, but the velocity of new developments seems to have accelerated with each year since 2017. This subjective insight doesn't speak to the veracity of the whistleblower testimonies, but – I find it an interesting trend to observe nonetheless.**\n\n---\n\n### The Disclosure Timeline\n\n#### ****2017****\n\n****December 16:****  \nThe New York Times publishes an article titled [\"Glowing Auras and ‘Black Money’: The Pentagon’s Mysterious U.F.O. Program,\"](https://www.nytimes.com/2017/12/16/us/politics/pentagon-program-ufo-harry-reid.html) revealing the existence of the Advanced Aerospace Threat Identification Program (AATIP), a previously undisclosed government effort to study UFOs.\n\n",

        "contents": "# Ultraterrestrial System - Unified Status Report\n\n**Date Generated:** June 25, 2025  \n**System Version:** Enhanced Integration v2.0  \n**Status:** ✅ **PRODUCTION READY**\n\n---\n\n## 🎯 Executive Summary\n\nThe Ultraterrestrial system is a comprehensive UFO/UAP research platform combining AI-powered analysis, spatial intelligence, and interactive research workflows.         "contents": "# Work Session Log\n**Date:** June 25, 2025  \n**Time:** 21:30:00 UTC  \n**Session Duration:** ~3 hours  \n**Engineer:** Claude + Liam Ellis  \n\n## 🎯 Session Objectives\nContinue development of the Ultraterrestrial Resurrection platform with focus on:\n1. Knowledge Base Loading Issue Resolution (Continued from Previous Session)\n**Time:** ~18:30 - 19:00  \n**Status:** ✅ Resolved  \n\n**Context:** User reported \"knowledge base isnt loading any of the local file data\" in the disclosure-rag dashboard. Investigation revealed the metadata/index.json was empty.\n\n**Root Cause:** \n- The &#96;metadata/index.json&#96; file contained no indexed documents\n- KnowledgeBaseCRUD system expected documents to be pre-indexed\n- No indexing process had been run on the 448 files in packages/knowledge-base\n\n**Solution Implemented:**\n- Created &#96;index_knowledge_base.py&#96; script to scan and index all files\n- Successfully indexed:\n  - 31 PDF case files (CIA documents, UAP reports)\n  - 407 transcripts (testimonies, interviews, podcasts)  \n  - 10 research articles\n- Modified &#96;data_sources_navigator.py&#96; to read directly from index.json\n- Fixed path resolution issues with absolute path calculations\n\n### 2.
